Run a comfortable distance at a slow pace. Our recommendation: 2 kilometers in 12 minutes.
Lie down on your stomach, with your hands against the ground. Straighten your arms and push upwards, while leaving your legs on the ground. Your back should arch upwards. Hold it for 10 seconds.
Kneel on the ground. Lean forward so your knees tuck your body. Stretch your arms forward and lean down until your face is almost on the ground. Hold for 10 seconds.
Stand up straight and curve your right arm above your head while leaning to the right. Repeat for the left side. Repeat three times.
Stand up and cross your legs. Cross your arms over your head. Lean to one side, then to the other. Repeat three times.
Lie on your back. Raise your knees and feet to make two 90-degree angles. Swing your knees on one side, then the other. Repeat three times.
Stand up straight and lean over forwards. Alternate touching your left and right foot with the opposite arm.

Start with your arms next to your body and you legs together. Then move both arms above your head while you jump. When landing your legs should be apart. When jumping again, the arms go down again and the legs go together. Imaging your arms and legs are bound together with a string. Do this 15 times.

We start standing upwards. Then we move down to the push up position. Perfom one push up and use the energy to jump wiht your legs between your arms. Now stand up and jump. After landing go down to the push up position again and repeat. Do 8 repetitions.
